parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: IspNameEn
parameters.description: The name of the ISP. If you leave this parameter empty, all ISPs are queried.

parameters.name: LocationNameEn
parameters.description: The name of the region. If you leave this parameter empty, data in all regions is queried.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vod describe-vod-range-data-by-locate-and-isp-service --domain-name example.com --start-time 2023-05-29T03:50:00Z --end-time 2023-05-29T03:55:00Z --location-name-en shanghai --isp-name-en unicom --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vod DescribeVodRangeDataByLocateAndIspService --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn unicom --EndTime '2023-05-29T03:55:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn shanghai --StartTime '2023-05-29T03:50:00Z'
